Description
US 90% Silver Coins – Pre-1965 Random mixture of different silver US minted coins.
The coins consist of .900 silver  and were minted in Philadelphia, Denver, San Francisco, and West Point.
Chance to start a collection or just have a surprise shipment.
The coins you receive will be a random year, random denomination & Circulated, Each denomination will be either the same type or a mixture. There could well be some that have a higher grading but as a minimum they will be circulated.
Please note pictures are for illustration purposes only, you may not receive the same coins. Coins will be randomly chosen.
Basically we will just grab a bunch of different coins up to the face value of $250 and ship them out to you. As your probably aware some coins can command a higher value than the junk value and there may well be some of these within the shipments. We really don’t have time to check each individual coins value and list them separately.
All coins are checked for purity so you can be assured you will be getting 90% silver coins with a troy oz weight of approximately 178.75 Troy oz’s
Video of coins in stock at the moment.
Design of the $250 Face Value Mixed Silver Coins (90%) Dimes Quarters and Half Dollars
We are pleased to present these $250 face value bags of 90% Silver Coins. we fill each bag with
various denomination’s
of pre-1965 silver coins depending on what we have in inventory at the time the order is placed. This means you will generally see a bag with a mixture of  dimes, quarters, & half-dollars. Coins minted in 1964 or earlier contain 90% silver and, as such, are very popular with investors and collectors alike. Each bag is composed of coins in varying degrees of condition. At our discretion,
Main Highlights of the $250 Face Value Mixed Silver Coins (90%) Dimes Quarters and Half Dollars
The Silver coins pre-1965 are struck in highly pure 90% fine silver.
The bags will contain approximately   approximately 178.75 Troy oz of silver
$250 face value
There can be any number  of different years in each batch, with different styles & mints. Common dimes as well as Doubled Die & Dates with blunt or pointed ends.
